# Robin Francis - AI Innovator & Community Leader

> AI innovator, community leader, and 3× hackathon winner building accessible, people-centric technology and scalable digital solutions.

## About Robin Francis
Robin Francis is an AI developer, program strategist, and community builder based in Kerala, India. He holds a B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering from Sahrdaya College of Engineering & Technology (First Class, CGPA 7.17). His work spans accessible technology, Generative AI solutions, student empowerment, and large-scale program execution. He believes in building technology that solves real human problems while uplifting communities through collaboration, mentorship, and creativity.

## Key Achievements
- **IEEE R10 Outstanding Volunteer Award 2024**: First student from the Asia-Pacific Region to receive this honor.
- **IBM Watsonx GenAI Challenge**: 1st Runner-Up — awarded for building an intelligent GenAI-powered solution.
- **3× Hackathon Winner**: Wins include GenAI challenges, food sustainability platforms, and game development competitions.
- **Champion of Impact — IEEE Computer Society**: Recognized for founding & leading TechX Infinia, a flagship event with 450+ participants.
- **Raised $2,650+ for Community-Impact Projects**: Successfully fundraised for various social initiatives.
- **National Bronze Medalist — .22 Rifle Shooting**: Awarded at a national competition in Delhi.

## Technical Skills
### AI & ML
Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, Computer Vision, Generative AI

### Backend & Data
Node.js, C++, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase, REST APIs

### Frontend & Tools
React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, Git/GitHub, Figma

## Featured Projects
- **SoulSync**: AI Companion for Cognitive Wellness — features facial recognition, emotion tracking, and memory recall for elders and caregivers.
- **FoodLoop**: AI Platform for Responsible Food Redistribution — reduces food waste using ML surplus prediction.
- **TechX Infinia**: Emerging Tech Flagship Event — founded and led a large-scale tech festival with 450+ participants.
- **IEEE R10 Career Fair**: Co-led the first international virtual career fair with 31 global recruiters and 245 participants.
- **STRIDE Website**: Official website for STRIDE Kerala — central digital hub for assistive technology innovation.
